release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.0: Comprehensive Design System Unslopping & UI/UX Elevation.
• Complete unslopping across all 49 mobile screens & components (Student, Parent, Auth, Onboarding, Admin).
• Standardized 4px/8px modular rhythm, eliminated neon glow halos and rainbow borders.
• Clamped typography to weight 600 max, enforced tabular figures on all numbers, timers, and scores.
• Replaced decorative emojis with crisp Lucide vector icons.
• Strict 1px hairline borders and mathematical nesting radius (inner_radius = outer_radius - padding).
